translations.web: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
translations.bsb: He who acquires wisdom loves himself; one who safeguards understanding will find success.
translations.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
